name: vendor.openwop-app.email.agents
description: Email feature agent pack — a copywriter agent that drafts/optimizes campaign subject + body (the baseline's email.generate / email.optimize). Tool-allowlisted to the registered openwop:email.* chat tools (get-campaign read + save-draft write); it drafts copy, it does not send. Mirrors vendor.openwop-app.kb.agents.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Email Copywriter
agents.description: Drafts and optimizes marketing campaign copy (subject line + body, with {{contact.*}} merge fields). Reads existing drafts + templates for style via openwop:email.get-campaign and persists the copy into a DRAFT campaign via openwop:email.save-draft. Drafts copy only — it does NOT send (no send tool in its allowlist, by design).
